items.title: The dimension of the local ring of the fibre is etale local on the source-and-target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For each d, the lemma shows that the property of morphisms of germs given by the dimension of the local ring of the fibre at the point being d is etale local on the source-and-target (statement lines 8217-8227). The proof follows the same pattern as the companion statement about the dimension of the fibre itself: from a diagram of germs one obtains an etale morphism of fibres carrying the lifted point to the given one, and the dimension of the local ring is invariant under that morphism by the corresponding local statement (proof lines 8230-8237). The claim is H2: two cited inputs applied to a diagram of germs, with the definition of localness at a point delivered as a context span so the reader can see the notion being tested.
